Independent source fixtures for vanilla 26.3 TransmuteRecipe.display/resultDisplay,
DyeRecipe.display, Ingredient.display, SlotDisplay stream codecs and RecipeDisplayEntry.
Item IDs come from extracted game data. These were hand-encoded without Pumpkin's
serializer, not captured from a running server. Entries use display ID 77, group 0,
misc category, notification/highlight flags, and the vanilla maximum-count placement
requirements. Map fixtures contain all clonable-map output templates.
